In this Act , unless the context otherwise requires-

such ammunition , but does not include gun powder or trade powder not intended or u sed
as such a component part;

muzzle-loading firearm of any of the categories referred to in Part s I, II and III respectively of the
Schedule hereto, and any componen t part of any such firearm ;
"public armoury" means a place or building establi shed or recognised as a public
armoury in accord ance with section 13 of thi s Act.
